detail: nflverse_game_id and week are not printed on the game summary. Ingest supplied nflverse_game_id=2026_07_IND_MIN and week=7.
The Game Weather field is blank. Roof/surface text is the stadium line; outdoor weather is printed as Cloudy.
The game summary prints made field goals in parentheses and missed field goals without them ('Field Goals (made ( ) & missed)'). result reads that notation. It is not computed from the score.
The first-half summary repeats the scoring plays already listed on the game summary page. Those repeat lines are not copied into scoring_plays.
First-half period score lines are a reprint of quarters 1 and 2, not a second scoreboard: Vikings 0 6=6 Vikings 16:06
Ten Longest Plays is not a CSV. pdftotext can wrap a play description into the next row, so those yard and quarter cells are not reliable. The same plays remain in play_by_play.
J.Taylor has printed td=0 while a type column is non-zero rush_td=1. The zero is stored as printed and was not replaced with a sum.
T.Hockenson has printed td=0 while a type column is non-zero rec_td=1. The zero is stored as printed and was not replaced with a sum.
Pass attempts and receiving targets are both stored as printed. IND printed pass attempts 22 and printed targets 21 differ.

The first-half defensive table lists 8 players and the final table lists 40. The first-half rows are stored as printed and were not filled from the play-by-play. Example: a first-half sack can be absent from the first-half defensive list.
[DOWNED] and [TOUCHBACK] rows are kept. The printed Total does not include them. bracket_row marks those printed labels.
